title: Ghalibaf: Iran Must Plan to Overcome 'Unjust' U.S. Sanctions
detail: Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that Iran must develop plans to overcome what he described as 'unjust' U.S. sanctions, signaling continued resistance to economic pressure from Washington. The remarks reflect the hardline stance of Iranian leadership against engaging on terms set by the United States, even as nuclear negotiations remain stalled.

media.caption: Iran's parliament speaker Ghalibaf calls for plans to overcome U.S. sanctions
